definitions.name: Sharp Records
definitions.description: P2 domain uses records with `required` members.
definitions.criteria: P2 dotnet project has >=1 `record` type with >=1 `required` member AND day-06 verification all_passed in stack dotnet

definitions.name: Null and Void
definitions.description: Nullable reference types on, warnings as errors, zero warnings in P3.
definitions.criteria: P3 dotnet project(s) set <Nullable>enable</Nullable> and <TreatWarningsAsErrors>true</TreatWarningsAsErrors> AND `verify: build p3` exits 0

definitions.name: Ahead of Time
definitions.description: P4 service published with Native AOT starts and answers /health/ready.
definitions.criteria: P4 dotnet project has PublishAot=true AND the AOT-published binary starts and GET /health/ready returns 200

definitions.name: State of the Saga
definitions.description: P6 saga state machine with a green compensation test.
definitions.criteria: P6 dotnet project has a saga state machine type AND a test exercising a compensation step passes (`verify: test p6` exits 0 with that test named in evidence)
